title: docs(qa): automation ledger — 23 checklist-accuracy findings of the 18.2.0 sweep, and the retired objectui pin wording
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94s6gRi2E8RhbDCCcrXW4Tp)_
Fixes #25840
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Applies the 24 `automation.json` lines of the 18.2.0 release sweep (wave anchor #25807) to `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json`, the only file touched. 23 lines are applied: 13 items revised, each with `revision` bumped and a `history` row citing the run record the line came from, plus the area recipe `qa-flow-status-doors` (recipes carry no revision of their own; the edit is recorded on `automation.trigger-status-contract`, its consumer). One line confirmed an item accurate and needs no edit. No line turned out to be a product defect.

The same file's retired objectui pin wording, which #26035 left to this card, is respelled to the current form (#26052): the objectui tree lives under `ui/` and `pnpm console:build` builds the console from it. History rows keep the old wording as records.

Every line was re-read against `origin/main` at base `9753d1637f` before editing; the file had no commit since the card was filed (last change 2026-10-24).

## Line by line

Retired pin wording, re-spelled in the same commit: `setup-packaged-automation-board` `fixtures.requires[0]` (the `.objectui-sha` bundle) and `fixtures.knownGaps[1]`, and `screen-flow-roundtrip` `fixtures.knownGaps[0]` (specs only runnable in an objectui checkout at the pinned revision; no console bundle built here). Both `automated.ref` rows now name their `ui/` paths. After the edit, a walk over every non-history string in the file finds no `objectui:build|refresh|bump|clean`, `.objectui-sha`, `build-console`, "pinned revision", "objectui checkout" or "objectui REPO".

## Gates

At head `890110d4` (base `9753d1637f`):

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: exit 0, `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`, line citations 0, symbol anchors 986/996 with 10 on the named residual.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 13 derived families, each run with its exit captured before any pipe, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:doc-formula-expressions` needed `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` built first (prerequisite exit 3, then exit 0).
- No package is touched, so no build or test closure is owed. `skip-changeset`: the diff is a QA ledger under `docs/qa/`, which no package ships.

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`'s standing fact on items whose `automated.ref` lives "ENTIRELY in the objectui repo" still says those specs are not in this checkout and that option (b) is running the pin "inside an objectui checkout at the pinned revision". After the `ui/` import those paths exist here. This PR does not touch RUNNER.md (file surface). Carrier: #26035, whose slice 2 respelled RUNNER.md's pin-script lines but not this standing fact.
- `setup-packaged-automation-board` `fixtures.knownGaps[0]` still routes "a locator or copy fix" to objectui under ADR-0054, and several `source` rows across the file cite `objectui packages/...` paths. Neither is pin-script wording, so both are left as written. Carrier: none, noted only.
- History rows cite `#25840` as `ref`, since the PR number is not known at authoring time.
